name: Combobox
intro: Root owns options and selection. Place Label, Control, Input, List, and option Item parts inside it. List supplies generated item IDs through its render callback.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns selection, query, filtering, and open state.

props.name: disableFiltering
props.description: Shows supplied options without built-in filtering.

props.name: showClearButton
props.description: Renders the clear button when true.

props.name: showToggleButton
props.description: Renders the toggle button when true.

props.name: filter
props.description: Regex template matched against each option label. Defaults to .*{{query}}.*; query substitutions are escaped literal text.

props.name: filterExtras
props.description: Capture-group regexes for additional placeholders in filter. The first capture replaces its placeholder.

props.name: ariaDisabled
props.description: Marks the control disabled for assistive technology while keeping it operable.

props.name: name
props.description: Machine form-bridge name. The React parts do not render a hidden select; use your own form bridge for the committed value.

props.name: ids
props.type: { root?: string; label?: string; input?: string; list?: string; trigger?: string; clearTrigger?: string }
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Use Root IDs when a label or external control needs a stable input or trigger target.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Control
parts.description: Groups the input and option buttons.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Spread an option from List's render callback onto Item so its generated id, value, and label stay together.

props.name: id
props.description: Generated ID from the rendered option.

parts.name: IndicatorGroup
parts.description: Groups the clear and toggle buttons.

parts.name: ToggleButton
parts.description: Opens or closes the option list.

accessibility: Provide a visible Label or another accessible name. Keep Item indices aligned with the filtered options passed to List.
